leadText:
McKenzie (Japanese: イサミ Isami) is a character of the day who appeared in Doin' What Comes Natu-rally.

 and first encountered McKenzie while he was trying to train his , nicknamed Naughty. When they asked what he was doing, he got scared and ran away. They soon encountered him again at a fair where Pokémon displayed their talents. McKenzie's father asked McKenzie and Naughty to look into 's future. However, he did the routine all wrong due to stage fright. Ash and the gang decided to help him, and Misty advised that McKenzie should wear a mask so that the audience wouldn't see his face. McKenzie was in the middle of trying out his new act when attacked the fair and stole Naughty, along with some other Pokémon.

He eventually got Naughty back, and after that, he used it to battle Jessie and her . All the while, an audience was watching him, but McKenzie wasn't fazed at all by it. McKenzie told Naughty to use on Arbok, making it confused and go after Team Rocket as a result. Ash then ordered to use , which sent Team Rocket blasting off. McKenzie was then asked by a schoolteacher if he could put on a show for the children. He agreed and did his performance perfectly. He even felt comfortable enough to take off his mask.
